name: Thread Artist Residency
note: No photo on Commons (no category, no files). Sources confirm the idea (a pitched roof inverted so it drains into two courtyards either side of a central gathering space, workshops and bedrooms at the ends, earth-brick walls, thatch on a steel and bamboo frame) but not the actual roof profile seen from outside, which is the whole point of a drawing. Not drawn; a section from the architect would settle it.

name: Tour Bois-le-Prêtre Transformation
note: No usable photo: Commons has only two files: one blurs the tower (French freedom-of-panorama rules), the other is mostly a street sign in front of the facade. Not drawn because sources disagree on the storey count (16 levels vs R+17, 49-50 m) and none give the tower's footprint or facade width, so the proportions of an elevation would be guessed. Known: 96 flats, prefabricated 7.5 x 3 m winter-garden and balcony modules added to the facades.

name: Yusuhara Wooden Bridge Museum
note: No free photo: the only Kuma photo from Yusuhara on Commons (File:Kumayusuhara.jpg) shows the Kumo-no-ue Hotel, not this museum. Sources confirm the central pier and stacked cedar brackets, but not the shape of the gallery and its 'inverted' roof on top or how the two ends (one 10 m lower) meet the ground, so it is not drawn. The architect sites could not be opened from here.
